Missing Arguments of a Function Call

Source: R/intern_.all_args_here_fill.R
dot-all_args_here_fill.Rd

Compute the $MISSING_ARG_NAMES, $MISSING_ARGS and $STATUS columns of the table of all_args_here() for one function call.

Usage

.all_args_here_fill(
  arg_full,
  arg_full_names,
  tempo_split,
  three_dots_log,
  pipe_log,
  i2,
  col1_i2,
  col2_i2,
  arg_user_setting_x,
  warn,
  warn_count,
  lib_path,
  error_text
)

Arguments

arg_full

List of the arguments of the called function, with their default values as copied into the call (empty value for the arguments without default value, or whose default value cannot be copied).

arg_full_names

Vector of character strings: names of the arguments of the called function. Can be NULL.

tempo_split

Vector of character strings: arguments written in the call.

three_dots_log

Logical vector: is each element of arg_full_names the ... argument?

pipe_log

Single logical value: is the call on the right side of a pipe (e.g., x |> base::rep(3))? If TRUE, the value of the pipe takes the first argument not written with its name and placed before ... (except if the placeholder _ or . is written as an argument), and the values written without name are kept without name in $STATUS.

i2

Single positive integer value: loop number in all_args_here().

col1_i2

Single positive integer value: code line number of the call.

col2_i2

Single character string: name of the called function.

arg_user_setting_x

Single character string: name of the checked function.

warn

Single character string of the warnings already raised, added to the error messages. Can be NULL.

warn_count

Single integer value (0 or more): number of warnings in warn.

lib_path

Vector of character strings or NULL: the lib_path value of the calling exported function, only passed on to arg_check(). No default value.

error_text

Single character string added to the error messages to name the calling functions (embed_error_text of the calling function). NULL is converted into "". No default value.

Value

A list:

  • col6: the $MISSING_ARG_NAMES.

  • col7: the $MISSING_ARGS.

  • col8: the $STATUS.

Details

Warnings:

  • requires saferDev::arg_check.

  • In the safer Backbone section "######## check of the required functions from the required packages", add also saferDev::arg_check when checking for the presence of .all_args_here_fill.
